info.title: Academic Paper Search & DOI Lookup: Crossref Citations
info.description:
Search Crossref scholarly works or look up DOIs: authors, journal, citations.

Runs on your own Apify account (pay-per-use). Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/crossref-papers-doi-lookup
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/crossref-papers-doi-lookup
Author: Public Records.

tags.name: runs
tags.description: Start a run and read dataset items

post.description: Starts the Actor asynchronously. Poll the returned run, then read dataset items. Docs: https://apify.com/publicrecords/crossref-papers-doi-lookup

application/json.schema:
{
  "title": "Crossref Paper Search and DOI Lookup input",
  "type": "object",
  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "properties": {
    "queries": {
      "title": "Search queries",
      "type": "array",
      "description": "Words to search for in titles, authors, journals and other bibliographic fields, one search per line (for example `large language models` or `LeCun deep learning 2015`).",
      "editor": "stringList",
      "prefill": [
        "large language models"
      ],
      "default": [
        "large language models"
      ]
    },
    "dois": {
      "title": "DOIs",
      "type": "array",
      "description": "DOIs to look up, one per line. `10.1038/nature14539`, `doi:10.1038/nature14539` and `https://doi.org/10.1038/nature14539` all work.",
      "editor": "stringList",
      "prefill": [
        "10.1038/nature14539"
      ],
      "default": [
        "10.1038/nature14539"
      ]
    },
    "maxResultsPerQuery": {
      "title": "Max results per search",
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "How many papers to return for each search query (1–1000). DOI lookups always return one row per DOI.",
      "default": 10,
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 1000
    },
    "sort": {
      "title": "Sort search results by",
      "type": "string",
      "editor": "select",
      "enum": [
        "relevance",
        "published",
        "is-referenced-by-count"
      ],
      "enumTitles": [
        "Relevance",
        "Newest first",
        "Most cited first"
      ],
      "default": "relevance",
      "description": "Order of search results. Relevance is Crossref's own match score; DOI lookups are not affected."
    },
    "fromYear": {
      "title": "Published from year",
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Only works published in or after this year (searches only).",
      "minimum": 1600,
      "maximum": 2100
    },
    "toYear": {
      "title": "Published until year",
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Only works published in or before this year (searches only).",
      "minimum": 1600,
      "maximum": 2100
    },
    "type": {
      "title": "Work type",
      "type": "string",
      "editor": "select",
      "description": "Limit searches to one Crossref work type.",
      "enum": [
        "any",
        "journal-article",
        "proceedings-article",
        "posted-content",
        "book",
        "book-chapter",
        "dissertation",
        "report",
        "dataset"
      ],
      "enumTitles": [
        "Any",
        "Journal article",
        "Conference paper",
        "Preprint",
        "Book",
        "Book chapter",
        "Dissertation",
        "Report",
        "Dataset"
      ],
      "default": "any"
    }
  }
}
